environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed into a private subnet (10.0.128.0/20) within a VPC that has no NAT gateway, no NAT instance, and no VPC endpoints configured for any AWS service. The subnet route table (rtb-0a3f7c9e2d) contains only the local route (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry. Security group sg-0f8b2a4c6e allows inbound TCP/8080 from the internal ALB only (sg-0d1e3f5a7b) and has a default-deny outbound rule with no egress rules defined (empty egress rule set, overriding AWS default allow-all). The task networking uses awsvpc mode with the ENI attached to this subnet. No proxy, sidecar, or service mesh is configured.

config.network: private subnet 10.0.128.0/20, no NAT-GW, no NAT instance, no VPC endpoints
config.security_group: sg-0f8b2a4c6e: ingress TCP/8080 from sg-0d1e3f5a7b only, NO egress rules (empty)
config.container_runtime: ECS Fargate, root user, default seccomp, awsvpc network mode
config.tmp_filesystem: tmpfs, world-writable, no noexec mount option
config.egress: none - no route to internet, no VPC endpoints, no NAT, empty SG egress rules
